mapper.insert: INSERT INTO cargo ( booking_id, shipper_id, cargo_type, weight, dimension_length, dimension_width, dimension_height, quantity, description, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, booking_status ) VALUES ( CAST(#{bookingId} AS UUID), CAST(#{shipperId} AS UUID), #{cargoType}, #{weight}, #{dimensionLength}, #{dimensionWidth}, #{dimensionHeight}, #{quantity}, #{description}, #{originUnlocode}, #{destinationUnlocode}, #{arrivalDeadline}, #{bookingStatus} )
mapper.select: SELECT id, booking_id, shipper_id, cargo_type, weight, dimension_length, dimension_width, dimension_height, quantity, description, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, booking_status FROM cargo WHERE booking_id = CAST(#{bookingId} AS UUID)

SELECT id, booking_id, shipper_id, cargo_type, weight, dimension_length, dimension_width, dimension_height, quantity, description, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, booking_status FROM cargo ORDER BY id

SELECT id, booking_id, shipper_id, cargo_type, weight, dimension_length, dimension_width, dimension_height, quantity, description, origin_unlocode, destination_unlocode, arrival_deadline, booking_status FROM cargo WHERE shipper_id = CAST(#{shipperId} AS UUID) ORDER BY id
